# SpeedCheck — Free Instant Internet Speed Test

> **Notice:** This tool has moved to [https://speed.solverspro.com](https://speed.solverspro.com).

> SpeedCheck is a free internet speed test that measures your download speed, upload speed, and latency (ping) in under 30 seconds using Cloudflare's global edge network spanning 330+ cities. No signup required — the test starts automatically when you open the page.

## Key Facts

- **Tool Relocation**: SpeedCheck has been consolidated into the SolversPro Internet Speed Test at [https://speed.solverspro.com](https://speed.solverspro.com).
- **Free**: 100% free with no subscription, no credit card, and no ads.
- **No signup**: Use instantly without creating an account or logging in.
- **Cloudflare edge network**: Powered by Cloudflare's anycast edge network spanning 330+ cities worldwide for real-world performance without ISP caching.
- **Metrics measured**: Measures download speed (Mbps), upload speed (Mbps), latency/ping (ms), jitter, and loaded latency (bufferbloat in ms).

## Surviving URL

- [SolversPro Internet Speed Test](https://speed.solverspro.com): Comprehensive network diagnostic tool featuring real-time download and upload bandwidth measurement, interactive speedometer gauge, latency (ping), jitter analysis, bufferbloat grading, and activity quality scores for gaming, streaming, and video calls.
